final_draft.answer: Changes to the main branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged, and this applies to administrators too.
final_draft.note: Shortened to one sentence as the reviewer asked. This matches the approved answer (CC8.1, valid until 2027-11-18). Both sources cover only harborlight/app, not any other repositories.

answer:e4edec3d-4426-41c2-9941-59c515176: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:7e2ed4eb-f584-4aba-a35f-f5b4861c2: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:6aecd592-a97d-463e-922b-e10de5f6c: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:d0f22223-bb39-4b5d-becd-34997a6ab: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
